paragraphs: As used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the terms "we," "us," "our," the "Company," "CleanSpark, Inc." and "CleanSpark" mean CleanSpark, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, unless otherwise indicated. Dollar amounts presented in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are presented in thousands, except per share amounts, bitcoin price, and information set forth under the heading "Bitcoin Mining Operations".

CleanSpark is a data center developer, until recently focused exclusively on bitcoin mining. We independently own, lease and operate a large portfolio of data centers and power assets across the United States with locations in Georgia, Tennessee, Mississippi and Wyoming for a total contracted power capacity of approximately 1,027 megawatts ("MW") as of September 30, 2025. We intend to continue our growth in these regions and are actively developing plans for additional capacity in these states and other domestic regions. We have no intention to mine, purchase or hold any crypto assets other than bitcoin at this time or in the foreseeable future, and we did not hold any other crypto asset as of September 30, 2025.

We design our infrastructure to efficiently, profitably and responsibly secure and support both bitcoin mining and AI and HPC workloads. We are currently analyzing our portfolio and pipeline of potential new developments and expansions of existing sites to identify opportunities for the maximum return on investment, which may include bitcoin mining, AI and HPC hosting and leasing, or a combination of both. We cultivate trust and transparency among our employees and the communities where we operate.

Through CleanSpark and our wholly owned subsidiaries, we have operated in the bitcoin mining sector since December 2020. We had an independent bitcoin mining operation in Massena, NY subject to a hosting agreement that operated 50 MW, which expired on December 31, 2024. The parties commenced wind-down procedures upon expiration.

Bitcoin mining has historically been our principal revenue generating business activity. Bitcoin was introduced in 2008 with the goal of serving as a digital means of exchanging and storing value. Bitcoin depends on a consensus-based network and a public ledger called a "blockchain," which contains a record of every bitcoin transaction ever processed. The bitcoin network is the first decentralized peer-to-peer payment network powered by users participating in the consensus protocol, with no central authority or intermediaries, that has wide network participation. The authenticity of each bitcoin transaction is protected through digital signatures that correspond with addresses of users that send and receive bitcoin. Users have full control over remitting bitcoin from their own sending addresses. All transactions on the bitcoin blockchain are transparent, allowing those running the appropriate software to confirm the validity of each and every transaction. To be recorded on the blockchain, each bitcoin transaction is validated through a proof-of-work consensus method, which entails demonstrating sufficient computation through the "proof of work" process to validate transactions and post them on the blockchain. This process is called mining. Miners are rewarded with bitcoins, both in the form of newly created bitcoins and transaction fees paid in bitcoin, for successfully constructing a block with the required network difficulty and disseminating that block to the global network of nodes. The mining process now represents the largest distributed computing network on Earth due to demand for bitcoin, the commodity, and the revenues associated with securing it.

Factors such as access to specialized mining servers, energy, electricity cost, environmental factors (such as cooling capacity) and location play important roles in mining. As of September 30, 2025, our operating mining units produced an average computing power of 45.6 exahash per second ("EH/s"), reaching a peak of 50 EH/s during the period. In bitcoin mining, "hashrate" is a measure of the computing and processing power and speed by which a mining computer mines and processes transactions on the bitcoin network. We expect to continue increasing our computing power through calendar year 2025 and beyond as we expand infrastructure at our owned sites in Tennessee and across our portfolio of data centers in Georgia, Mississippi, and Wyoming, while also pursuing regional expansion opportunities and evaluating strategic acquisition targets. A company's computing power, measured in hashrate, is a significant driver of its bitcoin mining revenue, and when compared to the global hashrate, determines the company's market share, making hashrate one of the most important metrics for evaluating bitcoin mining companies.

We owned approximately 336,544 miners, of which approximately 241,934 were in service as of September 30, 2025. The remainder primarily consists of new machines that are ready for installation at expansion sites, are under evaluation for relocation, or are awaiting repair. Our miners have an average age of approximately 15 months. We estimate the useful lives of our miners to be three years, reflecting a change made in fiscal year 2024. We do not have scheduled downtime for our miners; however, we periodically perform unscheduled maintenance and curtailments on our miners, but such downtime has not historically been significant. When performing unscheduled maintenance, we will typically replace the miner with a substitute miner to limit overall downtime. The miners in service as of September 30, 2025 had a range of energy efficiency (watts per terahash, "W/TH") of 13.5 to 29.5 W/TH with an average operating energy efficiency of 16.7 W/TH.

We obtain bitcoin as a result of our mining operations by contributing all of our computing power to a single mining pool operator, who is currently our sole customer. The contract with our mining pool operator is terminable at any time by either party. In exchange for providing computing power to the pool, we earn variable consideration in the form of bitcoin rewards, calculated using a predetermined formula agreed upon with the operator. This consideration is constrained until we can reasonably estimate the amount of mining rewards by the end of each day based on actual computing power contributed. At that point, we determine that a significant revenue reversal is unlikely and include such consideration in the transaction price. Providing computing power is an output of our ordinary activities and represents the sole performance obligation in our arrangement with the pool. We recognize revenue when the variable consideration is no longer constrained and our performance obligation is satisfied. As a result, we do not disaggregate revenue into block rewards and transaction verification fees.

We sell bitcoin from time to time to support operations and strategic growth and may also use bitcoin as collateral for lending arrangements. In April 2025, we launched our institutional-grade in-house trading function as we shift to a balanced approach between monetizing new production and building long-term holdings, and we plan to continue to integrate these strategies into our regular treasury management activities. As part of this strategy, we began entering into bitcoin-linked derivative contracts to economically hedge the volatility of bitcoin prices and to generate liquidity in support of core operating activities. These contracts serve as a strategic alternative to selling bitcoin directly and are intended to monetize our bitcoin holdings while managing exposure to adverse price movements. The types of derivatives utilized for this purpose may include bitcoin futures, options, and other structured instruments. These contracts are typically short-term in nature and may be cash-settled or settled in-kind. Treasury management activities may serve cash management, strategic growth, or bitcoin balance hedging, incremental other income or other general corporate purposes. Currently, we do not follow a prescribed formula or methodology for when or how much bitcoin to sell; instead, management makes these decisions based on working capital needs, real-time market conditions, and broader strategic considerations. We have begun to use a substantial portion of the bitcoin we mine to fund operations and to fund capital expenditures.

For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, we mined approximately 7,873 bitcoins, net of mining pool fees, representing a decrease of 11.0% compared to the 7,092 bitcoins mined in fiscal year 2024. This reduction was primarily due to the April 2024 bitcoin halving, which cut the per-block reward by 50%. Despite the halving, we nearly matched our prior-year production by significantly expanding our operational footprint, demonstrating the scalability and resilience of our mining strategy.

Through CleanSpark and our wholly owned subsidiaries, we maintain real property holdings associated with our bitcoin mining operations. A complete list of our subsidiaries is filed as Exhibit 21.1 to this Form 10-K.

Leveraging our power optimization, land acquisition, engineering, operations and construction expertise, we have been actively pursuing opportunities to develop portions of our sites and power pipeline for AI and HPC hosting and leasing. The expansion of AI, HPC and the increasing electricity requirements required for AI and HPC data centers make our data centers attractive to hyperscalers and other AI and HPC companies. This diversification strategy reflects our commitment to leveraging our expertise in energy management, data center operations and large-scale computing infrastructure to address rapidly growing demand in AI and HPC markets.

In October 2025, we added Jeffrey Thomas to our leadership team as Senior Vice President of AI Data Centers. Mr. Thomas is a global infrastructure veteran with over 40 years of leadership experience across the UK, US, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. In October 2025, we also announced that we are working with Submer, a global leader in sustainable, modular AI center design and construction to evaluate opportunities for future collaboration. The partnership is intended to enable us to focus on our core strengths in power and infrastructure while Submer delivers specialized cooling and deployment capabilities to support next-generation AI infrastructure at gigawatt scale.

Additionally, at the end of October 2025, we announced that we acquired rights to approximately 271 acres of land in Austin County, Texas and executed long-term power supply agreements totaling 285 megawatts to support the development of a next-generation data center campus. We believe this transaction positions us to deliver scalable, resilient, and energy-efficient capacity to meet accelerating demand from AI, cloud, and enterprise workloads.

Risks Related to Our Business
Risks Related to Governmental Regulation and Enforcement Operations
Risks Related to Our Securities
Our future success is difficult to predict because we operate in emerging and evolving industries that are subject to volatile and unpredictable cycles.
The markets in which we participate are highly competitive, and as we enter new markets, we are competing against companies with greater resources and capitalization.

We have an evolving business model and strategy, which includes an increasing focus on diversifying into constructing and operating data centers for AI and HPC companies, in addition to our bitcoin activities.
Our expansion into AI and HPC may divert resources from our core bitcoin mining operations, limit our power capacity for mining, and introduce operational complexity.
It may take significant time and expenditure to develop an AI and HPC hosting business through continued development at our facilities, and our efforts may not be successful.
We may not be able to timely complete our future strategic growth initiatives or within our anticipated cost estimates, if at all.
We may experience increased compliance costs as a result of future strategic acquisitions.
Our business expansion into AI and HPC services may be capital intensive and could affect our liquidity, results of operations and financial condition.
We maintain our cash at financial institutions, often in balances that exceed federally insured limits.
Our ability to achieve profitability is currently dependent on the price of bitcoin, which has historically been volatile.
We have a limited operating history and a history of operating losses and negative cash flow, and we may never achieve consistent profitability.
The impact of geopolitical and economic events on the demand for bitcoin is uncertain.
The value of bitcoin has historically been subject to wide swings, and we are exposed to bitcoin's price volatility and surrounding risks.
The development and acceptance of competing blockchain platforms or technologies may cause consumers to use alternative distributed ledgers or other alternatives.
Our reliance on a third-party mining pool service provider for our mining revenue payouts may adversely affect an investment in us.
Forks in the bitcoin network may occur in the future, which may affect the value of bitcoins held by us.
Banks and financial institutions may not provide banking services, or may cut off services, to businesses that engage in cryptocurrency-related activities.
Bitcoins held by us are not subject to FDIC or SIPC protections.
Bitcoins we mine or hold for our own account may be subject to loss, theft or restriction on access.
We may not have adequate sources of recovery if our bitcoin holdings are lost, stolen or destroyed.
paragraphs: We are subject to various risks that may materially harm our business, prospects, financial condition and results of operations. An investment in our common stock is speculative and involves risk. In evaluating an investment in shares of our common stock, you should carefully consider the risks described below, together with the other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The risks described below are not the only risks we face. If any of the events described in the following risk factors actually occurs, or if additional risks and uncertainties later materialize that are not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial, then our business, prospects, results of operations and financial condition could be materially adversely affected. In that event, the trading price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment in our shares. The risks discussed below include forward-looking statements, and our actual results may differ substantially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements.

Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our common stock speculative or risky. This summary does not address all of the risks we face. Additional discussion of the risks summarized in this risk factor summary, and other risks that we face, can be found below and should be carefully considered, together with other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
• volatile and unpredictable cycles in the emerging and evolving industries in which we operate;
• our reliance on our management team, and any failure by management to properly manage growth;

• our increasing focus on diversification into constructing and operating data centers for AI and HPC companies, as well as bitcoin mining, and the potential regulatory issues with entering into this new business;

paragraphs: 如本年度報告表 10-K 所述，文中所稱 "we," "us," "our," "the Company," "CleanSpark, Inc." 及 "CleanSpark" 均指 CleanSpark, Inc. 及其合併子公司，除非另有說明。本年度報告表 10-K 中所列的金額均以千美元為單位，除非為每股金額、比特幣價格或位於 "Bitcoin Mining Operations" 項下列出之資訊。

CleanSpark 為一資料中心開發商，直到最近專注於比特幣開採。我們獨立擁有、租賃並營運美國各州的大型資料中心與電力資產，包括喬治亞州、田納西州、密西西比州與懷俄明州，總合約電力容量約為 1,027 兆瓦（"MW"），截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日。我們有意繼續在這些地區擴張，並積極規劃在這些州及其他國內地區增加容量。我們目前並無意進行、購買或持有任何加密資產，除了比特幣，且截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，我們並未持有其他加密資產。
我們設計基礎設施，以高效、獲利且負責任的方式確保並支援比特幣開採與人工智慧（AI）及高效能計算（HPC）工作負載。我們目前正分析我們的潛在新開發與現有設施擴張的投資組合與管道，以尋找最大回報率的機會，這可能包括比特幣開採、AI 及 HPC 主機與租賃，或兩者結合。我們培養與員工及我們營運地區社區之間的信任與透明度。
透過 CleanSpark 及我們的 wholly owned 子公司，我們自 2020 年 12 月起已從事比特幣開採產業。我們在紐約馬薩納（Massena, NY）擁有獨立的比特幣開採業務，受託於一項主機協議，運作 50 MW，該協議於 2024 年 12 月 31 日到期。協議到期後，雙方開始進行收尾程序。

比特幣開採歷來為我們主要的收入來源業務活動。比特幣於 2008 年推出，目標為作為一種數位價值交換與儲存方式。比特幣依賴於基於共識的網路與稱為 "區塊鏈" 的公開帳本，記錄所有處理過的比特幣交易。比特幣網路為第一個去中心化的點對點支付網路，由參與共識協議的用戶驅動，無中央機構或中介者，且擁有廣泛的網路參與。每一筆比特幣交易的真實性透過與發送及接收比特幣用戶地址相應的數位簽名來保護。用戶對其發送地址擁有完全控制權。所有比特幣區塊鏈上的交易皆為透明，允許運行適當軟體的用戶確認每一筆交易的有效性。要被記錄在區塊鏈上，每一筆比特幣交易必須透過 "工作證明" 的共識方法進行驗證，這涉及透過 "工作證明" 過程展示足夠的計算能力以驗證交易並上傳至區塊鏈。此過程稱為開採。開採者會因成功建立符合網路難度要求的區塊並將其廣播至全球節點網路而獲得比特幣獎勵，包括新創建的比特幣及以比特幣形式支付的交易費用。目前的開採過程因比特幣的市場需求及保障其安全所產生的收入，已成為地球上最大的分散式計算網路。

如專用開採伺服器的存取、能源、電力成本、環境因素（如冷卻能力）及地點等因素在開採中扮演重要角色。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，我們運作中的開採單元平均計算能力為 45.6 億哈希每秒（"EH/s"），在該期間達到 50 EH/s 的峯值。在比特幣開採中，"哈希率" 是衡量開採電腦計算與處理能力及速度的指標，用以處理比特幣網路上的交易。我們預期會持續增加計算能力，直到 2025 年及以後，我們在田納西州自有設施及喬治亞州、密西西比州與懷俄明州資料中心的投資組閤中擴張基礎設施，同時也追求區域擴張機會並評估戰略收購目標。一家公司的計算能力，以哈希率為單位，是其比特幣開採收入的重要驅動因素，與全球哈希率相比，決定該公司的市場佔有率，使哈希率成為評估比特幣開採公司最重要的指標之一。

我們擁有約 336,544 個開採機器人，其中約 241,934 個在 2025 年 9 月 30 日為運作中。其餘主要為準備安裝於擴張設施的新機器、正在評估遷移或等待維修的機器。我們的開採機器人平均使用年齡約為 15 個月。我們估計這些開採機器人的使用壽命為 3 年，反映 2024 財年所做的變更。我們的開採機器人沒有預定的停機時間；然而，我們會定期執行非預定的維護與暫停，但此類停機時間歷來並未顯著影響。在執行非預定維護時，我們通常會以替代機器人替換開採機器人，以限制總體停機時間。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日運作中的開採機器人，其能源效率（瓦特每太哈希，"W/TH"）範圍為 13.5 至 29.5 W/TH，平均運作能源效率為 16.7 W/TH。

我們透過將所有計算能力貢獻給單一開採池運營商來獲得比特幣，該運營商目前為我們的唯一客戶。與我們開採池運營商的合約可由任一方隨時終止。我們透過提供計算能力給該池來獲得變動性對價，形式為比特幣獎勵，計算方式為與運營商預先協議的固定公式。此對價在我們能合理估計每日結束時的開採獎勵金額之前會受到限制。在該時點，我們判斷重大收入反轉的可能性不高，並將此對價納入交易價格。提供計算能力是我們日常活動的輸出，並代表我們與該池協議中的唯一履行義務。我們在變動性對價不再受到限制且履行義務完成時確認收入。因此，我們不會將收入分為區塊獎勵與交易驗證費用。

我們偶爾會出售比特幣以支應營運及戰略成長，也可能將比特幣用作貸款安排的擔保品。2025 年 4 月，我們啟動了機構級內建交易功能，因應我們轉向在 monetizing 新生產物與建立長期持有之間取得平衡的策略，並計畫持續將這些策略整合至我們的常規財務管理活動中。根據此策略，我們開始進行與比特幣相關的衍生合約，以經濟方式對抗比特幣價格的波動，並產生流動性以支應核心營運活動。這些合約是直接出售比特幣的戰略替代方案，旨在實現我們的比特幣持有量，同時管理對不利價格變動的風險。用於此目的的衍生品種類可能包括比特幣期貨、選擇權及其他結構性工具。這些合約通常為短期性質，可能以現金結算或以實物結算。財務管理活動可能用於現金管理、戰略成長或比特幣餘額對沖、其他收入或一般企業用途。目前，我們並未遵循特定的公式或方法來決定何時或出售多少比特幣；相反地，管理層根據營運資金需求、即時市場條件及更廣泛的戰略考量來做出這些決定。我們已開始使用我們開採的比特幣來支應營運及資本支出。
截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日財務年度，我們開採了約 7,873 個比特幣（扣除礦池費用），較 2024 財務年度開採的 7,092 個比特幣減少 11.0%。此減少主要是因為 2024 年 4 月的比特幣減半，使每個區塊的獎勵減少 50%。儘管有減半，我們透過大幅擴展營運規模，幾乎達成與前一年度相同的產量，這顯示我們礦業策略的可擴展性與韌性。
透過 CleanSpark 及我們的 wholly owned 子公司，我們持有與比特幣開採營運相關的實質財產。我們所有子公司的完整名單已於本 Form 10-K 的 Exhibit 21.1 申報。

我們運用在電力最佳化、土地取得、工程、營運及建設方面的專業知識，積極尋求機會開發我們的場地及電力管線，用於 AI 及 HPC 的 hosting 與租賃。AI、HPC 的擴張以及 AI 及 HPC 資料中心所需的電力需求增加，使我們的資料中心對 hyperscalers 及其他 AI 及 HPC 公司更具吸引力。此多元化策略反映我們致力於運用在能源管理、資料中心營運及大規模計算基礎設施方面的專業知識，以應對 AI 及 HPC 市場快速成長的需求。

2025 年 10 月，我們將 Jeffrey Thomas 加入領導團隊擔任 AI 資料中心副總裁。Thomas 先生是全球基礎建設的資深人士，擁有超過 40 年的領導經驗，遍及英國、美國、歐洲、非洲及中東。2025 年 10 月，我們也宣佈正在與 Submer 合作，Submer 是全球在可持續、模組化 AI 中心設計與建設方面的領導者，評估未來合作機會。此合作關係旨在讓我們專注於電力與基礎設施的核心優勢，同時由 Submer 提供專門的冷卻與部署能力，以支應下一代 AI 基礎設施的千兆瓦規模。
此外，2025 年 10 月尾，我們宣佈取得德克薩斯州 Austin 縣約 271 英畝的土地權利，並執行總計 285 兆瓦的長期電力供應協議，以支持下一代資料中心校區的開發。我們相信此交易使我們能提供可擴展、韌性強且能源效率高的容量，以應對來自 AI、雲端及企業工作負載的加速需求。

paragraphs: 本公司為資料中心開發商，直到最近專注於比特幣挖礦。我們致力於提供可擴充、節能的數位基礎建設，遍及美國各地。本公司獨立擁有、租賃並營運大量資料中心與電力資產，位於喬治亞州、田納西州、密西西比州與懷俄明州，總合約電力容量約為 1,027 MW，截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日。2025 年 10 月，本公司取得不動產並簽訂長期電力供應協議，位於德克薩斯州，以支持下一代資料中心校區的開發。本公司意圖持續在這些地區成長，並積極進行這些州及其他國內地區的擴充計畫。本公司在紐約馬塞納有一獨立資料中心運營，受託於一個 hosting 協議，運作 50 MW，該協議於 2024 年 12 月 31 日到期。雙方在到期後開始進行收尾程序。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，所有分配給本公司的 MW 已經騰空。本公司目前並無意挖礦、購買或持有任何其他加密資產，且截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，本公司並未持有任何其他加密資產。
我們設計基礎建設以負責任地確保並支持比特幣挖礦與人工智慧（AI）及高性能計算（HPC）工作負載。我們培養員工與我們運營地區社區之間的信任與透明度。

比特幣挖礦歷來為本公司主要的營收來源。例如取得專用挖礦伺服器、電力、電價、環境因素（如冷卻能力）與地點等因素，在挖礦活動中扮演重要角色。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，我們運作中的挖礦單元平均計算能力為 45.6 EH/s，期間達到 50 EH/s 的峯值。在比特幣挖礦中，"hashrate" 是衡量挖礦電腦計算與處理能力與速度的指標，用以挖礦並處理比特幣網路的交易。我們預期會持續增加計算能力至 2025 年及以後，隨著我們在田納西州自有場地與喬治亞州、密西西比州與懷俄明州資料中心組閤中擴充基礎建設，同時也追求區域擴張機會並評估戰略收購目標。一家公司的計算能力，以 hashrate 測量，是其比特幣挖礦營收的重要驅動力，與全球 hashrate 相較，決定該公司的市場佔有率，使 hashrate 成為評估比特幣挖礦公司最重要的指標之一。

本公司擁有約 336,544 個挖礦機器人，其中約 241,934 個在 2025 年 9 月 30 日為運作中。其餘主要為新機器，準備安裝於擴充場地，正在評估遷移，或等待維修。我們的挖礦機器人年齡從 1 至 57 個月不等，平均年齡約為 15 個月。自 2024 年 5 月起，我們估計挖礦機器人的使用壽命為 3 年（見附註 2 - 重要會計政策摘要）。我們並無預定的停機時間；然而，我們會定期進行非預定的維護與暫停，但此類停機時間歷來並未顯著。進行非預定維護時，我們通常會以替代機器人取代，以減少整體停機時間。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，運作中的挖礦機器人電力效率範圍為 13.5 至 29.5 W/TH，平均運作電力效率為 16.7 W/TH。

我們透過挖礦作業取得比特幣，透過將所有計算能力貢獻給單一挖礦池運營商，該運營商目前為本公司唯一客戶，根據合約，任一方均可隨時終止。作為交換，我們以比特幣獎勵形式獲得變動性對價，每日根據我們貢獻的計算能力，透過預先確定的公式計算。對價在不再受限制時計入收入，當我們可以合理估計獎勵，且重大反轉可能性不高，且我們提供計算能力的唯一履行義務已履行時。收入不按區塊獎勵與交易費用進行分項。有時，我們會出售比特幣以支持運作與戰略成長，我們也可能將比特幣用作貸款安排的擔保品。2025 年 4 月，我們啟動了一個機構級的內建交易功能，因我們轉向在 monetizing 新生產與建立長期持有之間取得平衡的策略，我們計畫持續將這些策略整合至我們的常規財務管理活動中。根據此策略，我們開始進行與比特幣價格波動經濟對衝的比特幣連結衍生合約，以產生流動性，支持核心運作活動。這些合約作為直接出售比特幣的戰略替代方案，旨在 monetize 我們的比特幣持有，同時管理對不利價格變動的風險暴露。用於此目的的衍生品類型可能包括比特幣期貨、選擇權及其他結構性工具。這些合約通常為短期性質，可能為現金結算或以現貨結算。財務管理活動可能服務現金管理、戰略成長或比特幣餘額對衝、增量其他收入或其他一般企業用途。目前，我們並未採用固定的公式來決定何時或多少比特幣出售，決策由管理層根據營運資金需求、實時市場條件、風險管理目標與更廣泛的戰略考量做出。
比特幣的價值歷來受到大幅波動。下表提供 2022 年 10 月 1 日至 2025 年 9 月 30 日間比特幣的每小時低價與高價範圍。

我們參與的市場競爭激烈，且在進入新市場時，我們將與擁有更多資源與資本的公司競爭。
本公司業務模式與策略持續演進，其中包括日益重視於為AI與HPC公司建設與營運資料中心，除了我們的比特幣業務之外。
我們擴展至AI與HPC領域，可能分散我們核心比特幣開採業務的資源，限制我們用於開採的電力容量，並引入作業複雜性。
開發AI及HPC hosting業務可能需要大量時間與支出，且本公司持續於設施內進行開發，本公司努力未必成功。

paragraphs: 本公司面臨多種風險，這些風險可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大損害。投資本公司普通股為一種投機行為，並涉及風險。在評估投資本公司普通股時，應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險，並配合本年度10-K表報表中包含的其他資訊。

下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。若下列風險因素中所描述的任何事件實際發生，或若後續有其他風險與不確定性因素浮現，而這些因素目前尚未為本公司所知悉，或本公司目前認為不重要，則本公司業務、前景、營運成果與財務狀況可能受到重大不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資於本公司股票的金額。下列所討論的風險包含前瞻性陳述，而本公司實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述有顯著差異。
以下為使投資本公司普通股成為投機或風險行為的主要因素摘要。此摘要並未涵蓋本公司所面臨的所有風險。有關下列風險摘要中所提及風險的進一步討論，以及其他本公司所面臨的風險，請參閱下文，並與本年度10-K表報表中包含的其他資訊一併考量。
• 新興且不斷演進產業中，本公司所面臨的波動且難以預測的週期；
• 本公司對管理團隊的依賴，以及管理層未能妥善管理成長的風險；
• 本公司日益重視多元化發展，進而投入建設與營運用於AI與HPC公司的資料中心，以及比特幣挖礦業務，並可能因進入此新業務而產生的潛在監管問題；
